title: The weather
summary: Ask what the weather is like, describe sun, rain, wind and snow, and give the temperature in degrees.
intro: English says 'it is hot' with an empty 'it'. Arabic names the weather instead: الْجَوّ حَارّ (the weather is hot), الْجَوّ غَائِم (it's cloudy). Rain has its own verb: تُمْطِرُ (it rains), سَتُمْطِرُ (it will rain). Today Yusuf calls from Amman, where it is cold and wet, while Daniel is enjoying the Cairo sun.
objectives: Ask كَيْفَ الطَّقْس؟ and answer with الْجَوّ + an adjective
Say that it is raining, snowing or windy
Give the temperature: دَرَجَةُ الْحَرَارَة + a number
Say what the weather will be like tomorrow

realLife.title: A call from Amman
realLife.story: On Monday evening Yusuf calls Daniel from Amman. Daniel and Layla are going to visit him next month, and Yusuf has a warning: the Jordanian winter is much colder than the Egyptian one. Daniel, sitting on his sunny balcony, finds it hard to believe.

sentences.en: It's hot and sunny in Cairo.
sentences.literal: the weather hot and sunny in Cairo

mistakes.why: Arabic has no empty 'it' for the weather. Say what is hot, al-jaww (the weather), then the adjective.

sentences.en: It rains a lot in winter.

sentences.ar: سَتَكُونُ دَرَجَةُ الْحَرَارَة خَمْسَ دَرَجَات فِي اللَّيْل.
sentences.en: The temperature will be five degrees at night.
sentences.literal: will-be degree-of the heat five degrees in the night

mistakes.why: daraja (degree) is feminine, so the numbers 3–10 drop their ة: khams darajāt.

sentences.en: Yesterday it was cold and cloudy.
sentences.literal: was the weather cold and cloudy yesterday

dialogue.title: Sun in Cairo, rain in Amman
dialogue.culture: Cairo gets almost no rain: a few showers in winter at most. Amman is high in the hills, so its winters are cold and wet, and snow falls there every few years. Weather forecasts on Arab television are given in degrees Celsius. The Dead Sea, the lowest place on earth, stays warm even in January.

lines.ar: مَسَاءُ الْخَيْر يَا دَانْيَال! أَنَا يُوسُف، مِنْ عَمَّان. كَيْفَ حَالُكَ؟ وَكَيْفَ الطَّقْس عِنْدَكُمْ فِي الْقَاهِرَة؟
lines.en: Good evening, Daniel! It's Yusuf, from Amman. How are you? And how's the weather where you are in Cairo?
segs: where you are (lit. at you, to a group)

lines.ar: أَهْلًا يَا يُوسُف! أَنَا بِخَيْر، وَالْجَوّ هُنَا جَمِيل جِدًّا. الْيَوْمَ الْجَوّ مُشْمِس، وَدَرَجَةُ الْحَرَارَة سَبْعٌ وَعِشْرُونَ.
lines.en: Hi, Yusuf! I'm fine, and the weather here is lovely. Today it's sunny, and the temperature is twenty-seven degrees.

lines.ar: يَا لَيْتَنِي مَعَكُمْ! هُنَا فِي عَمَّان الْجَوّ بَارِد وَغَائِم، وَالْيَوْمَ أَمْطَرَتْ كَثِيرًا.
lines.en: I wish I were there with you! Here in Amman it's cold and cloudy, and today it rained a lot.

lines.ar: تُمْطِرُ فِي عَمَّان؟ هُنَا فِي الْقَاهِرَة لَمْ أَرَ الْمَطَر مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً مُنْذُ وُصُولِي!
lines.en: It rains in Amman? Here in Cairo I haven't seen rain even once since I arrived!

lines.ar: نَعَم، فِي الشِّتَاء تُمْطِرُ كَثِيرًا، وَأَحْيَانًا يَنْزِلُ الثَّلْج عَلَى الْجِبَال. وَمَتَى سَتَأْتِيَانِ إِلَى عَمَّان، أَنْتَ وَلَيْلَى؟
lines.en: Yes, in winter it rains a lot, and sometimes snow falls on the mountains. And when are you and Layla coming to Amman?

lines.ar: سَنُسَافِرُ فِي دِيسَمْبِر، بَعْدَ شَهْر تَقْرِيبًا. هَلْ سَيَكُونُ الْجَوّ بَارِدًا جِدًّا فِي ذٰلِكَ الْوَقْت؟
lines.en: We'll travel in December, in about a month. Will the weather be very cold at that time?

lines.ar: نَعَم، فِي اللَّيْل تَكُونُ الْحَرَارَة خَمْسَ دَرَجَات أَوْ أَقَلَّ. لَا تَنْسَ مِعْطَفًا ثَقِيلًا!
lines.en: Yes, at night the temperature is usually five degrees or less. Don't forget a heavy coat!

lines.ar: خَمْسُ دَرَجَات؟ هٰذَا مِثْلُ الطَّقْس فِي شِيكَاغُو الْآنَ! أُخْتِي إِيمَا تَقُولُ: عِنْدَنَا رِيَاح قَوِيَّة وَمَطَر كُلَّ يَوْم.
lines.en: Five degrees? That's like the weather in Chicago now! My sister Emma says: 'We have strong winds and rain every day.'

lines.ar: طَبْعًا، شِيكَاغُو مَشْهُورَة بِالرِّيَاح! وَهَلْ سَيَنْزِلُ الثَّلْج هُنَاكَ قَرِيبًا؟
lines.en: Of course, Chicago is famous for its wind! And is it going to snow there soon?

lines.ar: رُبَّمَا فِي الشَّهْر الْقَادِم. إِيمَا تُحِبُّ الثَّلْج كَثِيرًا، أَمَّا أَنَا فَأُحِبُّ الشَّمْس وَالْجَوّ الدَّافِئ.
lines.en: Maybe next month. Emma loves snow, but as for me, I love the sun and warm weather.

lines.ar: إِذَنْ سَتُحِبُّ الْبَحْر الْمَيِّت! الْجَوّ هُنَاكَ دَافِئ حَتَّى فِي الشِّتَاء. سَنَذْهَبُ إِلَيْهِ مَعًا.
lines.en: Then you'll love the Dead Sea! The weather there is warm even in winter. We'll go there together.

lines.ar: رَائِع! وَمَا أَخْبَارُ الطَّقْس عِنْدَكُمْ غَدًا؟ هَلْ سَتُمْطِرُ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى؟
lines.en: Great! And what's the weather forecast for tomorrow where you are? Will it rain again?
segs: where you are (lit. at you, to a group)

lines.ar: نَعَم، سَتُمْطِرُ فِي الصَّبَاح، ثُمَّ سَتَكُونُ هُنَاكَ رِيَاح قَوِيَّة. سَأَبْقَى فِي الْبَيْت وَأَشْرَبُ الشَّاي!
lines.en: Yes, it will rain in the morning, then there will be strong winds. I'll stay at home and drink tea!

lines.ar: وَأَنَا سَأَجْلِسُ عَلَى الشُّرْفَة فِي الشَّمْس! سَلِّمْ عَلَى عَائِلَتِكَ، وَإِلَى اللِّقَاء يَا يُوسُف.
lines.en: And I'll sit on the balcony in the sun! Say hello to your family, and goodbye, Yusuf.

reading.title: Two cities, two kinds of weather
reading.ar: الْيَوْمَ الْجَوّ فِي الْقَاهِرَة مُشْمِس وَدَافِئ، وَدَرَجَةُ الْحَرَارَة سَبْعٌ وَعِشْرُونَ. فِي عَمَّان الْجَوّ بَارِد وَغَائِم، وَأَمْطَرَتْ كَثِيرًا. غَدًا سَتُمْطِرُ هُنَاكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى، وَسَتَكُونُ هُنَاكَ رِيَاح قَوِيَّة. فِي دِيسَمْبِر سَيُسَافِرُ دَانْيَال وَلَيْلَى إِلَى عَمَّان، فَيَجِبُ أَنْ يَأْخُذَا مَعَاطِفَ ثَقِيلَة.
reading.en: Today the weather in Cairo is sunny and warm, and the temperature is twenty-seven degrees. In Amman it is cold and cloudy, and it rained a lot. Tomorrow it will rain there again, and there will be strong winds. In December Daniel and Layla will travel to Amman, so they must take heavy coats.

quiz.prompt: What is the weather like in Cairo today?
What does Yusuf tell Daniel to bring to Amman?
Where is the weather warm even in winter?
Which word has the heavy ṭ (ط), not the light t (ت)?

completion: Well done! You can talk about the weather today, yesterday and tomorrow. Next: the four seasons.
